Policies.Name: Regulation JG-R1: STUDENT DISCIPLINE
Regulation JG-R1: STUDENT DISCIPLINE

fields.Content:
The Policy Review  Committee recommends regulations CBG-R1, CBG-R2 and CBG-R3 be eliminated because of the procedure used by the Board of Education working with Missouri School Boards Association on Standards and Indicators in the MSBA Superintendent Evaluation tool.   

Administration would like to convert IKE-R1 to an Administrative Procedure.  

Regulations KG-R1 and KG-R2 are being submitted for review.  

Administrative Procedure JFCL-AP (1) is being submitted for review.  

Several Administrative Procedures were discussed and the administration will review and submit to the Board for review and Board of Education questions.  These Administrative Procedures include DID-AP-(1), EBAB-AP(1), EBAB-AP(2), EBAB-AP(3), EEA-AP(1), EHBD-AP(1), EHBD-AP(2), GBEBC-AP(1), GBL-AP(1), GBL-AP(2),GCBC-AP(1), GCBC-AP(2), GDBC-AP(1), GDBC-AP(2), IGB-AP(1), JECA-2-AP(2), JGE-AP(1), JHCD-AP(2),  and JHD-AP(1). 

Administrators will review the administrative procedures, inform staff, board and include in the district policy manual.  A reminder Administrative Procedures do not require board of education approval.

Approve Regulations - Ron Fritz
  1. a. CBG-R1:  Committee recommends this regulation be eliminated because of the procedure used by the Board of Education working with Missouri School Boards Association on Standards and Indicators in the MSBA Superintendent Evaluation tool. 
  2. b. CBG-R2: Committee recommends this regulation be eliminated because of the procedure used by the Board of Education working with Missouri School Boards Association on Standards and Indicators in the MSBA Superintendent Evaluation tool. 
  3. c. CBG-R3: Committee recommends this regulation be eliminated because of the procedure used by the Board of Education working with Missouri School Boards Association on Standards and Indicators in the MSBA Superintendent Evaluation tool. 
  4. d. IKE-R1: Administration would like to convert this Regulation to an Administrative Procedure.
  5. e. JG-R1: This Regulation has been reviewed twice in previous board of education meetings and will be voted on by the Board during the October regular board meeting. 
  6. f. KG-R1: Submitted for Review October 28, 2024
    g. KG-R2; Submitted for Review October 28, 2024

Discuss Administrative Procedures - Administration.
Several Administrative Procedures were discussed. District administrators will review the Administrative Procedures and submit to the Board for review and Board of Education questions.
List of Administrative Procedures include:
  1. DID-AP-(1) Inventory Management
  2. EBAB-AP(1) Hazardous Materials (Asbestos Control)
  3. EBAB-AP(2) Hazardous Materials (Handling Disposal of Mercury)
  4. EBAB-AP(3) Hazardous Materials (Chemical Hazard Communication Program)
  5. EEA-AP(1) Student Transportation Services - Remove
  6. EHBD-AP(1) Artificial Intelligence Use - Remove
  7. EHBD-AP(2) Artificial Intelligence Use - Remove
  8. GBEBC-AP(1) Personnel Records
  9. GBL-AP(1)Personnel Records
  10. GBL-AP(2) Personnel Records (Immigration Records)
  11. GCBC-AP(1) Professional Staff Fringe Benefits
  12. GCBC-AP(2) Professional Staff Fringe Benefits
  13. GDBC-AP(1) Support Staff Fringe Benefits
  14. GDBC-AP(2) Support Staff Fringe Benefits
  15. IGB-AP(1) Accommodation of students with disabilities
  16. JECA-2-AP(2) Eligibility to Enroll
  17. JFCL-AP(1) A+ Scholarship Program OK for Review on 10/28.
  18. JGE-AP(1) Discipline of students with disabilities
  19. JHCD-AP(2) Administration of Medications to Students
  20. JHD-AP(1) Student Counseling Program
  21. Administrators will review the administrative procedures, inform staff, board and include in the district policy manual. A reminder Administrative Procedures do not require board of education approval.
Dr. Ron Fritz
